item.title: Dolly Parton brought music and books to the world
item.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Jeff Conyers, president and vice chair of the Dollywood Foundation, about Dolly Parton's philanthropy, including the Imagination Library.

item.title: Tulsa bakes in high temperatures and high electric bills
item.description: The cost of electricity has been rising faster than inflation. Tulsa, Okla., has been baking in triple-digit temperatures. And some residents are in danger of having their power cut off.

item.title: Mexican cattle allowed in the U.S. after a yearlong ban
item.description: A border crossing in Arizona opened to cattle from Mexico for the first time in more than a year. This despite a parasite being found on the Mexican side. U.S. ranchers are upset.
item.content:encoded: A border crossing in Arizona opened to cattle from Mexico for the first time in more than a year. This despite a parasite being found on the Mexican side. U.S. ranchers are upset.

item.title: What the Supreme Court's ruling on mail-in voting means for Nevada's voters
item.description: The Supreme Court on Monday handed President Trump an interim win in his effort to limit mail-in voting.

item.title: Colorado resort town suing ICE's landlord over detentions
item.description: A city in Colorado is suing the landlord of an ICE processing facility there, saying its detentions there violate local zoning codes.

item.title: Sen. Darline Graham wins GOP nomination for U.S. Senate in South Carolina
item.description: In a major win for President Trump who went all in for the political newcomer, Sen. Darline Graham beat out longtime Congressman Ralph Norman in a special election primary runoff in South Carolina.

item.description: NPR's Adrian Florido talks with Ken Rider of the California Energy Commission about a new rule for more efficient tires, which could cut the greenhouse gas emissions that cause climate change.

item.title: High-intensity sprints can trigger molecular changes in the bloodstream
item.description: Scientists are increasingly interested in how different exercise intensities can trigger different responses in the body. A new study finds that an all out sprint may have unique benefits.

item.title: Dolly Parton, one of country music's most singular performers, has died at age 80
item.description: The artist was a star performer in country music and went on to become one of the genre's most recognizable and universally adored ambassadors to broader popular culture.
